Chapter Summary 
• The musculoskeletal system includes the bones 
of the skeleton and the cartilage, ligaments, and 
other connective tissues and muscles. 
• The integumentary system includes the skin, 
hair, nails, sweat glands, sebaceous glands, and 
nerves on the skin.
